title: Canonical algebraic realization and scalar-unit normalization of pro-etale inverse image
statement:
Let $h:T'\to T$ be any morphism of schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], with compatible small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and the specified inverse images and unit $\eta_h$ of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$, put $RI=h^{-1}R$, and write $I(M)=h^{-1}M$ for the specified inverse-image functor on $R$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

There is an algebraic inverse-image presentation [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image] whose module functor is exactly $I$ on objects and morphisms and whose underlying sheaf identifications are the canonical ones of the specified inverse image. Define $T(M)=RI\otimes_{RI}I(M)$ and $T(f)=1\otimes I(f)$. The specified functor $T$ therefore has the object and morphism scalar-extension identifications for the identity coefficient map $RI\to RI$.

The multiplication maps $a_M:T(M)\to I(M)$, characterized by $a_M(b\otimes m)=bm$ on local pure tensors, are a natural family of $RI$-module isomorphisms. Their inverses are the scalar insertions $q_M:m\mapsto1\otimes m$; in particular $a_Mq_M=1$ and $q_Ma_M=1$ as sheaf maps.

For any normalized CanonicalRingedTensorComparison $(q,\mu)$ for this specified $T$, the identity coefficient map and the above algebraic presentation [def-weil-pbc-canonical-ringed-tensor-comparison], put
$$b_{M,N}=(a_M\otimes a_N)\circ\mu_{M,N}\circ a_{M\otimes_RN}^{-1}.$$
For every object $V$ of $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$, $s\in M(V)$ and $t\in N(V)$, let $h^{-1}s$ denote the unit image in $I(M)(T'\times_TV)$, and similarly for $t$ and $s\otimes t$. Then
$$b_{M,N}\bigl(h^{-1}(s\otimes t)\bigr)=h^{-1}s\otimes h^{-1}t.$$
Here each pure tensor is its image under the presheaf-to-sheaf tensor map.

source.place: Tag 03D2, label lemma-pullback-module (operation transport); Tag 03EL, label lemma-tensor-product-pullback, and Section 03EK, label section-tensor-product. Agent-written realization of the specified inverse image and cancellation of identity scalar extension in an arbitrary normalized comparison; original parent proof steps 1-2.

proof.text: Use the uniquely unit-normalized underlying set identifications for the specified ring and module inverse images of [lem-pur-proetale-unit-underlying-identifications]. The module identification is natural: transpose its square through the set adjunction and apply naturality of the module unit. For each operation graph, transpose the proposed equality of sheaf maps through the same adjunction. Naturality of the set unit reduces the equality to preservation of addition, multiplication, zero and one by the ring unit and preservation of addition, zero and scalar multiplication by the module unit. This constructs an AlgebraicInverseImage with modules exactly proEtaleModuleInverseImage, retaining the ring_unit and module_unit equations. The private transport_binary and moduleSetsIdentification_naturality proofs from the existing algebraic-presentation module implement these transposition calculations.

Apply Mathlib ModuleCat.extendScalarsId on every section ring. Its inverse inserts 1 and its forward map sends b tensor m to b times m. The maps commute with restriction, since the scalar-extension restrictions preserve pure tensors, hence give an isomorphism of presheaves. Apply module sheafification and compose with its invertible counit. Naturality of the sheafification unit and its triangle identity prove the multiplication and insertion formulas on sheafified pure tensors. The sectionwise scalar-extension functor, followed by sheafification, gives exactly the specified changeOfRingsHom maps. Naturality of ModuleCat.extendScalarsId and of the sheafification counit gives natural multiplication. Whisker with the specified module inverse image to obtain scalar and multiplication.

For any comparison k, k.q_one and the inverse multiplication formula identify its insertion with multiplication.inv on every section. Form the cartesian product Z of the underlying sheaves of M and N, with its projections x,y and its pure-tensor pairing z. Evaluate k.pure on the set-adjunction unit image of (s,t) in inverse image of Z. Unit naturality for x,y,z gives the three unit sections used in the conclusion. Apply tensorHom of the two multiplication maps. Reuse the proved independent-universe pure_restrict and pure_map section-calculus helpers of CochainInverseComparison. They follow from naturality of tensorObjIsoSheafification and the sheafification unit and show that tensorHom acts factorwise on pure tensors; the inverse identities then cancel both factors. The two multiplication-insertion cancellations give precisely the normalized section formula.
